stance_basis: expressed interest in undeveloped parcels along Parnell Avenue as compensation for land taken from Hamlin-Garland School
summary: The City of Milwaukee School Board expressed interest in acquiring undeveloped parcels along Parnell Avenue as compensation for land taken from Hamlin-Garland School due to the Airport Spur project. Their position is conditional, tied to receiving adequate land compensation rather than outright opposition or support for the project itself. The Division of Highways indicated it would investigate this interest.
